# Unit test for function solve
def test_solve():
    # Mixed case letters get swapped
    assert solve("Hello") == "hELLO"
    assert solve("Hello World") == "hELLO wORLD"
    
    # All lowercase becomes uppercase
    assert solve("abc") == "ABC"
    assert solve("python") == "PYTHON"
    
    # All uppercase becomes lowercase
    assert solve("ABC") == "abc"
    assert solve("XYZ") == "xyz"
    
    # No alphabetic characters: string is reversed
    assert solve("1234") == "4321"
    assert solve("1234!") == "!4321"
    assert solve("!@#$%") == "%$#@!"
    
    # Letters and non-letters mixed: only letters swap case
    assert solve("a1b2c3") == "A1B2C3"
    assert solve("12ab34") == "12AB34"
    
    # Single characters
    assert solve("a") == "A"
    assert solve("A") == "a"
    assert solve("5") == "5"
    
    # Empty string
    assert solve("") == ""
    
    # Spaces and punctuation preserved
    assert solve("a b c") == "A B C"
    assert solve("a.b,c!") == "A.B,C!"
    
    # Unicode letters
    assert solve("café") == "CAFÉ"
    
    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_solve()
